excluded.2026_08_CHI_SEA: no final score in nfl_schedule for the requested weeks

advance_rule.rule: advance only if mean log loss and mean Brier are both lower than baseline and the 95% interval for the log-loss difference is below zero

limits: Retrospective Week 1-8 cohort; not a locked holdout.
Sack and turnover actuals are sums from nflverse weekly player-game rows.
Player workload MAE includes positive observed carries/targets only.

rush_attempts.participation_rule: Score only players with a positive observed carry/target count. A zero-touch or absent row is not treated as confirmed inactive.

targets.participation_rule: Score only players with a positive observed carry/target count. A zero-touch or absent row is not treated as confirmed inactive.
